artworks.title: Roger Palmer, Earl of Castlemain
artworks.description: The engraving depicts the upper torso and head of a man facing slightly to the right. He has distinct facial features, long curled hair, and is dressed in period attire. He is enclosed within an oval frame with textured design. The image includes a crest and text identifying him as "The Right Earle of Baron of Hon:ble Roger Castlemayne Limbrick etc." The background is filled with lines and cross-hatching.

artworks.title: John Colet, D.D.
artworks.description: The image shows a man sitting with a book in front of him. He is facing forward with his head slightly tilted, hands resting on the book. The man's expression is neutral, with prominent eyebrows, deep-set eyes, a straight nose, and slightly pursed lips. He has shoulder-length hair under a dark cap. He wears a plain dark robe and no jewelry. The background features an arch-like structure with textured design and two coat of arms-like symbols on each side. Below the image is an inscription about the man.

artworks.title: Domenico Contarino
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the shoulders up. He is positioned with his body turned slightly to one side while facing forward. The man has a long, pointed nose, prominent cheekbones, and a goatee. His hair appears shoulder-length and light in color, peeking out beneath a hat. He is wearing a richly detailed hat with patterned designs and a long flowing cloak with buttons. The portrait is set within an oval frame decorated with intricate borders and inscriptions. The lower portion features ornate decorative elements with a heraldic shield, set against a plain background with fine, etched lines.

artworks.title: Abraham Cowley
artworks.description: This image shows a portrait engraving of a man from the chest up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left but gazes directly at the viewer. His facial features are prominent with a straight nose and full lips. His hair is long, reaching past his shoulders, curly, and parted in the middle. He is wearing a dark cloak or robe with a large, white collar visible at the neckline. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the individual. The background consists of a textured pattern within an octagonal frame, and there is an engraved signature at the bottom reading "Ms. Abraham Cowley" along with "W. Faithorne Sculp."

artworks.title: Abraham Cowley
artworks.description: The image displays a bust of a man depicted from the chest up on a pedestal. The man has long, wavy hair reaching his shoulders with soft curls. His face is smooth with a straight nose and slightly pursed lips. He wears a draped garment fastened at the shoulder. The background features an arched niche with decorative detailing. The pedestal has an inscription with the name "ABRAHAMVS COVLEIVS Anglus."

artworks.title: Oliver Cromwell
artworks.description: The image is an engraving depicting a portrait of a man, shown from the shoulders up. He is positioned facing forward, with his head slightly turned to the side, looking directly at the viewer. The man has long hair that falls to his shoulders, with a slight wave. His facial features include a slightly furrowed brow, prominent cheekbones, and a serious expression. He wears an elaborate armor with a visible shoulder piece and a collar. Surrounding the central portrait are four smaller circular portraits: one on top of the central image labeled "DAVID, R.P.," another labeled "SALOMON, R." on the opposite side, and two more below labeled "ALEXAND. MAG." and "C. IVL CAESAR." The background consists of a textured pattern, and beneath the portrait is a block of text in Latin.

artworks.title: Sir William Davenant
artworks.description: The portrait is of a person shown from the shoulders up, facing slightly to the left with their face turned towards the viewer. They have distinctive facial features, long, curly hair cascading around their shoulders, and a laurel wreath. The clothing appears formal, likely a robe or cloak. The oval-shaped portrait is set against a background of fine lines, with a decorative banner at the bottom displaying the name "Sr. William D'Avenant K." in elegant script.

artworks.title: Lord Thomas Fairfax
artworks.description: The image is an engraving showing the upper body of a man in a classical portrait style. The man's head is turned slightly to his left, while he gazes directly at the viewer. He has a prominent nose, thin lips, and a small mustache along with a well-groomed beard on his chin. His eyes are deep-set, and he has shoulder-length, wavy hair that frames his face. He is wearing a high-collared garment beneath a suit of armor that covers his shoulders and chest. The background consists of an oval frame with the inscription "THOMAS. L? FAIRFAX • BARON • OF • CAMERON" as well as "Obit : 1671 Ætat. 60." The background inside the oval features a cross-hatching pattern.

artworks.title: Sir Richard Fanshaw, Bart.
artworks.description: This is an engraved portrait of a man shown from mid-chest up, facing slightly to his left. He has long, slightly wavy hair, a straight nose, and a slightly solemn expression. He wears an elaborate lace collar and a dark garment. The background features a detailed circular frame, a heraldic crest, and an inscription honoring Richard Fanshawe as a knight and ambassador.

artworks.title: Sir John Fortescue
artworks.description: The image shows an engraved portrait of a man seated with his hands clasped in front of him. He has defined facial features, short hair, and wears attire typical of a person of distinction. In the background, there is a decorative frame with a cartouche bearing the name "Sr. John Fortescu" and titles written in cursive script.

artworks.title: Valentine Greatrakes
artworks.description: The image shows a three-quarter view of an adult and a child standing from the waist up. The man has long wavy hair, a broad forehead, and wears period clothing. He places one hand on the child's head and cheek while the child looks up at him. The child has short hair and wears a simple collared garment. In the background, there is a detailed illustration of a landscape with trees, hills, and figures engaged in a social or ceremonial scene. The background features textured patterns typical of engravings of that era.

artworks.title: Sir Bevil Grenville
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a historical outfit with metallic armor, holding a baton or staff. He has medium-length, wavy hair, a mustache, and is positioned in a three-quarter pose. In the background, there is an ornate oval frame and decorative elements like a helmet and sword. Latin phrases are inscribed in the frame.

artworks.title: John Hacket, Bishop of Lichfield and Coventry
artworks.description: The image features a man in clerical attire with a skullcap. He is looking towards the viewer with an expressive face. The man has short gray hair and wears a clerical gown with a high collar and a stole. The frame around him is intricately engraved with inscriptions. Above him are two ribbons with the words "Serve God and be Chearfull." The background has a crosshatch pattern, and below are details about the man's age, date of death, and a poetic passage. The setting is formal and historical, likely for commemoration.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: This is an engraving of a man from the waist up, positioned facing slightly to the left but looking directly ahead. He has a long beard, mustache, and combed-back hair. He wears a ruff around his neck, a dark robe with light-colored sleeves, and holds a book in his left hand. The robe has a medallion on the chest. In the background, there is a lined pattern. On the left, there is a coat of arms with a bishop's mitre. Below the portrait, a description in Latin and English identifies him as Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich, with details of his death and age.

artworks.title: Joseph Hall, Bishop of Norwich
artworks.description: The image shows an upper half portrait of a man with a long, pointed beard and moustache, wearing a cap and a dark robe with a white ruffled collar. He is holding an open book or manuscript, with a medallion around his neck. In the background, there are vertical lines, a shield with a coat of arms, and a wall of books.

artworks.title: Sir James Harrington, Bart.
artworks.description: The image shows an upper-body portrait of a man facing forward. He has long, curly hair, a well-groomed mustache, and a subtle smile. The man wears a large, white lace collar over a dark garment and a white cravat around his neck. Intricate details frame the portrait, including curving lines and an emblem with a coat of arms beneath the image. The background is textured with fine dot patterns. Surrounding the image are inscriptions and decorative elements.

artworks.title: Sir James Harrington, Bart.
artworks.description: The engraving shows a man from the chest up, slightly turned to his left and looking at the viewer. He has long, wavy hair, a small moustache and pointed beard. He wears a dark cloak over a textured, lace-collared white shirt. The portrait is in an octagonal frame with decorative elements, including a banner and a crest at the bottom center. The background has a dark, cross-hatched pattern. The engraving is titled "The True Effigies of Sir James Harington Knight and Baronet," with additional inscriptions in the outer border, possibly in Latin.

artworks.title: Lady Katherine Harrington
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman from the waist up. She has an oval face with delicate features and her eyes are directed forward. Her hair is styled in neat curls that cascade down the sides of her face. She is wearing an elegant gown with an ornate bodice adorned with a brooch and a pearl necklace around her neck. Her earrings are long and teardrop-shaped. The portrait is set within a geometric frame with a textured background, and below the portrait is an ornate coat of arms. The text at the bottom of the image describes her as Lady Katherine Harington, wife to Sir James Harington.

artworks.title: William Harvey, M.D.
artworks.description: The image shows a bust sculpture of a man, depicting only his head and shoulders. The man is positioned with his body turned slightly to the side while his face looks directly forward. His facial features include cheekbones, a straight nose, and a mouth with slightly downturned corners. His hair is of medium length, covering the ears, and appears wavy. The clothing styled on the bust resembles a classical toga or robe. The pedestal has the inscription "GULIELMUS HARVEUS." There is no jewelry. The background has fine parallel lines, creating a textured appearance.

artworks.title: William Harvey, M.D.
artworks.description: The image depicts a bust sculpture of a man, shown from the shoulders up. The man has an elongated face with pronounced cheekbones, deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, and a stern expression. His hair is medium length, wavy, and parted in the middle, with a slightly disheveled appearance. Draped over his shoulders is a textured fabric resembling a gown. The pedestal bears the name "GVLIELMVS HARVEIVS" and is adorned with classical decorations. The background features a detailed line engraving with parallel horizontal lines.

artworks.title: Thomas Hobbes
artworks.description: This image is a portrait showing an older man with long white hair, a frowning expression, and wearing a dark robe with a wide white collar. He is seated or standing formally with an ornate oval frame in the background featuring Latin inscriptions.

artworks.title: Thomas Hobbes
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with his upper torso visible. He is facing slightly to the left, with his head turned towards the viewer. The man has a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, a long, narrow nose, and a small mouth. His hair is shoulder-length and wavy, with a short mustache and pointed beard. He is wearing a dark robe with a wide, white collar and is not holding any objects. The background is textured and dark, and the portrait is framed by an oval with an inscription around it.

artworks.title: Henry Rich, Earl of Holland, K.G.
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a man in traditional 17th-century attire. He has long hair, a mustache, and a goatee. The portrait is framed with intricate details and decorative script text below provides information about the individual's titles.

artworks.title: Richard Hooker
artworks.description: The image features an engraved portrait of a man wearing traditional academic attire. The man has a stern expression, a prominent nose, a neat beard, and styled hair. He is encased within an ornate architectural frame adorned with cherubic figures, a laurel wreath, a decorative banner with text, sculpted busts, and detailed carvings. The backdrop includes globes and architectural embellishments. Below the portrait is a text panel. The overall background is intricately shaded to highlight the decorative elements of the engraving.
